title: Tie a file to an object's lifetime
description: Resource Acquisition Is Initialization (RAII) ties a resource's lifetime to an object's lifetime. You can follow the file from construction to destruction.

steps.description: Constructing f opens app.log for appended writes.
The function throws if the stream failed to open. Otherwise, it writes the message and a newline.
The stream's destructor closes the file when f leaves scope. This ties cleanup to scope exit, including exit through an exception.
